channelUrls.description: YouTube channel URLs, handles (@username), or channel IDs (UCxxx). Required when inputMode is 'channel'.
channelUrls.title: Channel URLs

hashtags.description: Hashtags to scrape Shorts from (e.g. #cooking, sports). Required when inputMode is 'hashtag'. Include or omit the # prefix.
hashtags.title: Hashtags

includeDetails.description: Visit each Short's page for exact views, likes, comment count, publish date, duration, category, sound and captions. Turn off for a faster, cheaper listing-only run (views as displayed, no likes or dates).
includeDetails.title: Include Exact Details

includeMembersOnly.description: Channel mode only. Also collect members-only Shorts when YouTube offers the 'Members only' filter on that channel's Shorts tab (a gradual rollout — the actor retries the tab a few times and notes it in the status message when unavailable). Member rows count toward maxShorts and cost up to two player requests each.
includeMembersOnly.title: Include Members-Only Shorts

inputMode.description: Where to find Shorts. 'channel' reads a channel's Shorts tab, 'hashtag' a hashtag's Shorts feed, 'search' YouTube search results filtered to Shorts, 'direct' specific Shorts URLs or video IDs, 'sound' finds other Shorts that use the same sound as seed Shorts.
inputMode.title: Input Mode

market.description: YouTube market/region for localized content. Affects the language of metadata returned.
market.title: Market / Region

maxShorts.description: Maximum number of Shorts to return per channel, hashtag or search query (per run in direct mode).
maxShorts.title: Max Shorts Per Source

oldestPostDate.description: Only include Shorts published on or after this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty to include all. Works in channel, search and direct modes; hashtag mode needs 'Include Exact Details' because dates come from each Short's page.
oldestPostDate.title: Oldest Post Date

searchQueries.description: Keywords to search on YouTube, keeping only Shorts results. Required when inputMode is 'search'.
searchQueries.title: Search Queries

shortUrls.description: Shorts URLs, youtu.be links, watch URLs, or 11-character video IDs. Required when inputMode is 'direct'; used as the sound seeds when inputMode is 'sound'.
shortUrls.title: Shorts URLs or IDs

sortShortsBy.description: Order of the channel's Shorts tab, matching the buttons YouTube shows: newest first (default), most popular, or oldest first. Falls back to newest when a channel does not offer the chosen order.
sortShortsBy.title: Sort Shorts By
